personal.bio: I'm passionate about solving complex problems with analytical thinking and result-oriented development. I specialize in building scalable web applications across the full stack, from backend systems to modern frontends, with a focus on delivering high-performance solutions under tight deadlines.

about.summary: Looking for a Full-Stack Web & Mobile Developer role — on a permanent contract or as an apprenticeship (alternance) — alongside the Web & Mobile Development programme at Università di Corsica Pasquale Paoli (2026 intake). Available immediately. I build and ship real products across the full stack — enterprise web apps (Laravel, Spring Boot, Angular), native and cross-platform mobile apps (SwiftUI, React Native / Expo), and the AI and automation that make them useful. I take things from spec all the way to the App Store, with a focus on performance, clean architecture and maintainability.
highlights: Shipped mobile apps — native iOS (SwiftUI) and React Native / Expo, live on the App Store
On-device AI/ML (Apple Vision, Google ML Kit) and data-scraping / automation pipelines
Full-stack web with Spring Boot, Laravel, Flask, Angular and React
API design & integration (REST, SOAP, JWT) and CI/CD with Docker, Kubernetes and Jenkins
Database design across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Supabase
